name: Nda Mekok
description: Nda Mekòk (meaning the House of Stones in the local Beti/Ewondo language) is a cultural, ecological, and tourist village located in Emana, Yaoundé, Cameroon. It is a green recreational and events space focused on nature, local traditions, and outdoor gatherings.
bonASavoir: it's located in forested area be careful of snakes and other wild animals, also the place is not well known by locals so you may need to ask for directions
